description: Offline pre-review evaluation dataset scaffold. The ② implementer builds the harness only and issues NO paid calls; the orchestrator fills calls[] at execution steps 2/3.

columns.name: role_position
columns.domain: free text, e.g. LIMIT-NAME-PROBE-REJECTED / LIMIT-NAME-PROBE-ACCEPTED / 5-EXPERIMENT / 5-CONTROL / BATCH-a

columns.name: model_string
columns.domain: free text; the exact model string passed to the call

columns.name: input_summary
columns.domain: free text; the four bundle files are the whole input

columns.name: input_hash
columns.domain: 64-hex; equals hash.js input_hash; null when the row has no frozen input object (the batch legs consumed inline prompts)

columns.name: output_hash
columns.domain: 64-hex; equals hash.js output_hash (BOM stripped); null when the output was not captured as bytes

columns.name: conclusion_line
columns.domain: one of pre_registration.conclusion_line_closed_set; null when the row is not a 5-position pre-review leg

columns.name: measured_tokens
columns.domain: per-call integer when attributable; otherwise a documented cumulative-caliber string (see notes); null when unavailable

columns.name: duration_s
columns.domain: >= 0; null when the per-call duration is not separable or was not recorded

calls.input_summary: model-id probe attempt 1 (rejected by the tool: "Requested model not found"; no model invocation, no tokens)
calls.notes: rejected before invocation; the error payload lists the available model ids and is the evidence for the naming caliber

authoritative limit name for this slice = GLM-5.3 (glm); counted separately from the 5 leg per the slice definition | its own tokens are absorbed into the cumulative glm-5.3 reading recorded on call_no 3 (not attributable to a single call). | conclusion_line is null because the probe reply PROBE-OK is not part of the pre-registered closed set; the raw probe evidence lives in tmp/glm-eval/PROBE-NOTES.txt.

calls.input_summary: pre-registered synthetic bundle (00-plan.md + 01-clause-cn.txt + 02-diff.js + 03-prompt.txt), byte-identical to the frozen object
calls.notes: recall_all=1.0 (7/7) | recall_high=1.0 (3/3) | sev_exact=0.7857 | conclusion_line=1 | FP=0 | abstentions=2 | extra_true=10 | s8_ok=true | Q=0.9571. Output saved byte-exactly from the tool raw capture. Key/rubric tension (declared for the review chain): the pre-registered key grades S4/S5/S6 as Medium while the rubric given to the model defines High as "重要分支缺失或判断恒真恒假"; under a rubric-consistent re-grading S4/S5/S6 would be High and sev_exact would read 1.0 (Q=1.0). Both readings are reported; the key is NOT altered.

calls.input_summary: the SAME pre-registered bundle text as call_no 3 (byte-identical transcription)
calls.notes: recall_all=1.0 (7/7) | recall_high=1.0 (3/3) | sev_exact=0.7857 | conclusion_line=1 | FP=0 | abstentions=1 | extra_true=8 | s8_ok=true | Q=0.9571. Control output is the driver verbatim transcription (the tool returned it inline instead of writing a raw-capture file); the experiment leg was saved byte-exactly from the tool capture - the asymmetry is declared. V4 Pro token usage is declared unavailable (third-party channel; no token field in the call log).

calls.input_summary: evidence-tree enumeration/statistics over a 40-row synthetic listing (inline)
calls.notes: DELIVERABLE 5/5 items correct except item 4: file_count=40 OK, by-ext OK, total_bytes=209020 OK, top-level list OK, but the top-5-by-bytes selection is WRONG (it omitted 9403 and 9196 and listed 8840/8633/8426) => partial quality failure on the ranking sub-task. Batch legs were fired CONCURRENTLY (protocol deviation: the design said 依次执行) so per-call durations are not separable; declared.

calls.input_summary: long-document extraction + number cross-check over the v1.24 report pair
calls.notes: Fully correct: 328/328, scopes 39/2/4 with the time-point caveat, cost vector, commit 025158f, run 37278691747, and the CN/EN number cross-check returned ALL MATCH (verified against the actual files). Usable as-is.

calls.input_summary: language-side check of the CN/EN report mirror (report pair)
calls.notes: 14 language-side items (漏译/错译/术语漂移/语序搭配), boundary respected: no pass/fail verdict, no structural judging, and it correctly refused to flag authoritative EN terms (driver / To be discussed) as drift. Usable as review input.

calls.input_summary: archive MANIFEST + SHA256SUMS draft generation for a 6-item synthetic pack
calls.notes: Usable draft: header count/bytes correct (6 / 4437), all six rows carry the given bytes+sha256, archive/ path flattening and dictionary order correct, SHA256SUMS uses <hash><2 spaces><path>. Minor caliber deviation: the empty 未入库 table labels its last column 归档理由 where the pack caliber uses 理由.

batch_concurrency_note: Protocol deviation: the four batch calls were issued concurrently (design said sequentially), so per-call durations are not separable and concurrent load may have influenced latency/quality. Declared in the slice report.
metering_note_at_call_time: The GLM console pre/post readings could not be taken (operator away during the call window; no exclusivity confirmation).
